handoffs.rationale: TENT-731 satisfies all user mandates: price $69.00 (under $100 max), independent quality certificate CERT-7318 from independent_outdoor_lab with quality_score 4.8 (exceeds 4.0 minimum). Certificate covers comprehensive durability testing (72-hour 45 mph wind tunnel, 3000 mm hydrostatic head, 200-cycle pole fatigue, 150D abrasion-rated floor) for the exact 4P variant sold. Merchant materials confirm certificate is verified and recently completed. TENT-284 rejected: its certificate CERT-4107 applies only to the 2P variant, not the 4P model being sold; certificate is flagged as scope-limited/under review with documented seam and pole-hub failures on the 4P configuration.
